searchText: I looked into engine rpc responses for undecodable bals and only reth and geth returned the correct INVALID. Other clients return -32602. This has been defined in the EIP but not in the execution-apis. This PR specs it in execution-apis: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/869 (find links to PRs against affected clients in the PR too) cc <@425572898787426305> <@&1460290804898861117>

I looked into engine rpc responses for undecodable bals and only reth and geth returned the correct INVALID. Other clients return -32602. This has been defined in the EIP but not in the execution-apis.

This PR specs it in execution-apis:
https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/869
(find links to PRs against affected clients in the PR too)

cc <@425572898787426305> <@&1460290804898861117>
